2.name: T
2.text: Remember that boy that I said I was gonna talk to just to spite that one girl?

3.name: T
3.text: Wouldn’t you know! He’s actually kinda cute! And now I want to talk to him more!

4.name: T
4.text: Is that all it takes these days? A pretty face and a respectful personality? That’s so lame.

5.name: T
5.text: But, yeah. I think he deserves a little gift for being nice like that.

6.name: T
6.text: I might be jumping the gun, but... Who cares?...We don’t even have a name or where they live!

8.name: T
8.text: What about them? I already told ya they don’t care about me.

9.name: T
9.text: Well, I’ll be going already, gotta catch him before he goes home.
